verdicts.reason: A just drops the whole banner into the middle of the square at its original size, leaving about 60% of the canvas as empty white bands above and below. The text is small and there's no rearrangement, but the composition, brand and graphics are intact and the text stays readable. B breaks 'HOHOHO AGENCY' into two lines with very different sizes, crams the decorations into a tiny strip that collides with 'HOHOHO', and scatters crescent and triangle fragments clipped at hard edges. Its layout has no grid, balance or recognisable link to the original, so it's unusable.
